description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order to declare that the Excise Duty on Motor Cars and other Motor vehicles
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the declaration of new excise duty rates on specific goods (motor vehicles) through a statutory order issued under the Excise (Special Provisions) Act. It constitutes a regulatory matter involving the modification of tax regulations and compliance requirements, which falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5). While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the regulatory function rather than being primarily about government personnel changes or portfolio assignments.
